name: Store (Uncompressed Packaging)
summary: Packages files into a single container without applying any compression algorithms.
analogy: Putting loose papers into a cardboard binder without folding or shrinking them.
what_you_gain: Instant packaging speed strictly bound by disk read/write throughput (zero CPU load).
what_you_lose: Zero byte savings; archive size equals the sum of input file sizes.
best_for: Files that are already compressed (e.g., MP4, JPEG, MP3, ZIP) or when speed is paramount.
avoid_for: Plain text, code, log files, or uncompressed raw data where compression can save 70%+ space.
go_deeper: Standard ZIP Method 0. Bypasses entropy coding and dictionary parsing entirely, streaming raw bytes directly into the archive container.
